content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe offer a streamlined experience for selling courses, including integrated payment processing, marketing tools, and customer management. However, their geographic limitations exclude many potential users. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a comprehensive suite of tools that empower creators without the need for intermediaries. COREMERCH's solutions allow you to create and operate your online store with complete ownership of your data and product delivery, ultimately providing a more robust foundation for digital selling.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving a vast majority of the global population without access. PayPal's restrictive policies can lead to account suspensions, holding funds indefinitely without appeal, exacerbating financial instability for creators. Sovereign commerce stacks, on the other hand, eliminate the dependency on such institutions. By utilizing crypto payment systems like NOWPayments, creators in restricted countries can sell their courses without fear of censorship or financial exclusion, ensuring they retain control over their earnings.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal impose transaction fees and can take days to process payments, which can be detrimental for creators needing immediate access to their funds. PayPal’s potential for fund holds adds another layer of uncertainty. In contrast, using sovereign infrastructure with NOWPayments allows for instant payment processing, with minimal fees (0.5%) and no buyer account requirements. This efficiency and transparency in costs provide a straightforward pathway for creators to monetize their work without unnecessary delays.
Sovereign infrastructure means true ownership and control over your digital products.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With traditional platforms, users often face restrictions on data ownership and must comply with platform rules. This means losing control over customer information and how products are delivered. Sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to own everything post-deployment, ensuring that they maintain full control. Automated systems facilitate immediate product delivery upon payment confirmation, streamlining the entire process and enhancing customer satisfaction while allowing creators to focus on developing their content.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries, choosing sovereign commerce infrastructure is a strategic decision. If you need a quick setup with minimal products, the Sovereign Starter Stack suffices. For those requiring more robust capabilities, the Edge Commerce Stack offers additional features and support. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is an all-in-one solution, providing everything needed to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce presence seamlessly, ensuring you can operate independent of traditional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
No more fear of account suspensions or frozen funds with crypto payment solutions.

Your Deployment Checklist

Identify your digital product and target audience. Choose the appropriate COREMERCH stack based on your needs. Set up your hosting environment using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for secure crypto transactions. Load your products and ensure delivery methods are in place. Launch your online store and begin marketing your courses.
